from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for i in cuts:
            if i > start: out.append((start, i))
            start=i+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs=segments(h, sep_rows); cs=segments(w, sep_cols)
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            bg=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            marked=sum(v != bg for v in vals)
            row.append(1 if marked == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-2e6f2eb2.py'
path.write_text(program)
